name: Kuberr
description: God who grants Virot Maglan's dreams.

description_citations.text: "The Secrets of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Averru takes part in killing the white and green Numena, leaving only himself, Lowallyn and Kuberr.
timeline.quote: Averru participated in killing the white and the green Numena

citation.text: "Averru", section "Ancient Dominion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona encases the Numena in stone; Kuberr suffocates and Lowallyn is freed, then stomped to death by his own magma giant under Karona's control.
timeline.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated

citation.text: "Averru", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Visions of Kuberr send Braids to Aphetto, where she prepares for the Patriarch and becomes his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: was rewarded by becoming his second-in-command

citation.text: "Braids", section "In league with the Patriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids helps Phage and Kuberr survive an assassination attempt and kills the Cabal Patriarch with a nightmare beast.
timeline.quote: she killed the Cabal Patriarch instead with one of her nightmare beasts

citation.text: "Braids", section "Succumbing to Dementia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The reincarnated Kuberr takes over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.
timeline.quote: The reincarnated Kuberr took over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal is left with no leader and no god and is presumed defunct around 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: the Cabal was left with no leader and no god

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, a Cabal group's spell summons the demonlord Belzenlok, who maims the cabalists and demands they serve him instead of Kuberr.
timeline.quote: the demonlord Belzenlok burst forth from the rift from the Abyss it created

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan pacts with Kuberr and founds the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Virot Maglan sealed a pact with the god Kuberr and gained the power to kill using touch

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer completes his shikar with Kamahl and sees a vision of Kuberr.
timeline.quote: He also saw a vision of the Cabal's god Kuberr

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona's presence destroys the Grand Coliseum as her worshippers tear its foundation apart.
timeline.quote: her very presence led to the destruction of the Grand Coliseum

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage sways Sanctum for the Cabal, and Akroma declares war on the Cabal and learns Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god Kuberr.
timeline.quote: to be the mother of the reincarnation of the Cabal god, Kuberr .

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage gives birth to Kuberr, and Braids recovers her sanity and summons a dementia monster that devours the Patriarch; Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal in place of Kuberr.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuberr and Akroma's armies fight at Sanctum, which has become a twisted reflection of itself.
timeline.quote: The angel and the Cabalist fight bitterly and without mercy.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona annihilates the city of Aphetto while Lowallyn and Kamahl escape through a portal.
timeline.quote: just before she annihilates the city in the blink of an eye

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: His dreams are granted by the god Kuberr
